author: Zew
body:
Ok, I'll do this again if I have to.

IGN: Zew
Banned for kill aura

I am appealing because there is a lack of evidence of me using a hacked client.
I understand everyone makes mistakes.
I am an experienced player on the overcast (https:oc.tc/Zew) and have previously been in some respected teams. Morever, I have decently high elo on badlion.

Tanpopo, avicus map dev who is also a ref on the overcast said he would vouch for me.

I am thus asking for the ban to be revoked, as I don't want to lose this server, as it is one of the only 1.7 servers left.

Thank you for your consideration.
A swift response would be greatly appreciated.
